name: superagnt
description: superagnt_ — the agent value layer. The base plugin carries the MCP server (data sources, workspace Postgres, schedules, canvases) plus the base skill set; blueprint plugins add packaged workflows on top.

plugins.name: superagnt
plugins.description: The superagnt MCP server + base skills: external data in one call, a workspace Postgres, recurring automations, shareable canvases. OAuth on first tool call — the consent screen doubles as signup.

plugins.name: audience-radar
plugins.description: The Audience Radar blueprint: an agent that mines X for what your audience talks about on a schedule and writes cited content-idea reports. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin (MCP server + base skills) as a dependency.

plugins.name: competitor-mindshare
plugins.description: The Competitor Mindshare Monitor blueprint: identical daily X measurements per brand, logged to your workspace database with a shareable trend dashboard. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.

plugins.name: gtm-prospecting-desk
plugins.description: The GTM Prospecting Desk blueprint: ICP-filtered company and people discovery, verified emails, scored rows and outreach drafts in one compounding pipeline table. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.
